note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，第二轮（头一轮以外的各幕）之一：六条地区主线 #1165 到 #1170 余下的十八幕。

nodes.name: 倒悬书库
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: a small warm lantern in the thief's hand on the left, against cold blue-green dark, with faint pale light seeping from the pages of thousands of hanging books
nodes.camera: low on a heap of fallen books, looking up into a library that hangs upside down overhead; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep in an underground labyrinth, a library that hangs upside down: its floor is far overhead, and from it bookcases as tall as towers hang downward like stalactites, a spiral staircase winds the wrong way up, and loose books drift slowly upward through the air. Among the hanging bookcases, high in the dark and cut off by the top of the frame, something enormous is coiled: a long eyeless body the colour of deep night, speckled with small points of light, its blunt head lowered a little, scenting. In the middle, on an island made of a great heap of fallen books, a gaunt bearded swordsman in the rotted gear of an explorer sits with his back against a broken pillar, facing us: hollow cheeks, long tangled grey-streaked hair, a notched sword across his knees, alive, his head just lifted and his eyes wide with disbelief. In front of him on the right, in full profile facing left toward him, stands a small girl who looks fifteen: damp silver hair cut at the shoulders, mist-blue eyes, an old traveller's cloak too big for her with the sleeves rolled three times. She is unhurt and calm. Her right hand holds out to him a worn star-shaped bronze seal; her left hand hangs at her side. On the left, seen directly from behind, stands the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf, a warm dark brown ponytail and a dark grey hooded jacket; her left hand holds a small lantern up at shoulder height and her right hand holds a coil of rope. Loose pages and motes of pale light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：三条失落支路里的头一处，剑士困在倒悬图书馆，吞层兽守着。困了二十年的剑士是成年人。露希亚照未成年画。

nodes.name: 落闸
who: the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf
nodes.light: a cold blue-white glow from a falling gate of light in the middle, against the dark of a stone hall, with a small hard glint of gold from a shard held in a fist beyond the gate
nodes.camera: low in the entrance hall, close behind the thief's right shoulder, looking at the gate and the man on its far side; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the great entrance hall to an underground labyrinth beneath a clock tower; huge still gears and a pendulum hang in the dark overhead, and a broad stair leads down into blackness. Across the head of that stair a sealing gate is coming down: a portcullis made of bars of blue-white light, already two thirds of the way to the floor. On the far side of the gate, on the first steps going down, stands a veteran explorer of about fifty, facing us: a square grey beard, a scarred brow, a heavy long coat hung with rows of old guild badges, a pack and coiled rope. His right fist is raised to the height of his chest and closed round a jagged shard of golden crystal that glows between his fingers; his left hand holds a short brass rod, the key that is closing the gate. He looks back at the people on this side with a hard, settled face and does not hurry. On this side of the gate three of his own crew, men and women in the same kind of gear, are caught outside it: one hammers on the bars of light with both fists, one has dropped to her knees, one stands with his arms hanging, all three seen from behind. Around them four tall stone-and-bronze relic golems are rising out of the floor, eyes lighting. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, the lower-city thief with the faded red scarf stands with a knife low in her right hand and her left arm flung out to hold back a small silver-haired girl in an oversized cloak who stands unhurt beside her in full profile, looking at the man. Dust and blue sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：格雷温抢走支路的钥片，封住钟楼和迷宫的入口，放出遗迹魔像，连自己的部下也当成弃子。他要往更深处去的缘故不画。

nodes.name: 熄灯
nodes.light: rings of small warm lamps going dark from below, against the blue-black of the pit, with a cold glitter like starlight on the body of the thing that climbs
nodes.camera: from the rail of the highest ring, looking steeply down into the pit past the two girls at the rail; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the rim of an enormous pit, a well wide enough to hold a city, seen from the rail of its highest ring. Below, ring under ring of walkways, stairs and hanging lamps go down the wall into the depth, hundreds of lamps on every ring. From the bottom upward the lamps are going out: the lowest rings are already black, and on the ring where the dark has just arrived the lamps are dying one after another. In that dark, climbing the wall of the pit, is a beast as large as a district: a long heavy body the colour of deep night, speckled all over with small points of light like a starry sky, with a blunt head and a mouth wide enough to take in a whole ring of the wall; stones and broken walkways fall away under its claws. It is cut off by the bottom of the frame, so that we see only its head, its shoulders and one forelimb reaching up. In the foreground two girls stand at the iron rail. On the right, in full profile facing left and looking down, is a small girl who looks fifteen: damp silver hair cut at the shoulders, wide mist-blue eyes, an old cloak too big for her; she is unhurt, and both her hands hold a star-shaped bronze seal against her chest. On the left, seen directly from behind, is a young woman of eighteen with a warm dark brown ponytail, a dark grey hooded jacket and a faded red scarf; both her hands grip the rail and she leans over it. Behind them, small and far along the rim, people are running with lanterns and a bell is swinging. Sparks from dying lamps and flecks of cold light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：深层前沿叫吞层星兽吞了，它顺着迷宫往上爬，外环的灯一盏接一盏暗下来。米娅只画背影，不拿立绘当参考（参考图留给画风）。

nodes.name: 黑旗
who: the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat
nodes.light: bright late-morning sun from the upper right on white stone and gold banners, with soft blue shadows, and petals in the air
nodes.camera: low on the street, close to the kneeling knight and the griffin's foreleg, looking up past them at the roofs; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a festival morning on the grand avenue of a white and gold imperial capital: garlands, gold banners with a sun emblem, a parade halted in confusion. A great golden griffin, eagle-headed and lion-bodied, has just been brought down onto a crushed parade float in the middle of the street; it lies on the wreck of flowers and painted boards with its wings half spread, panting, its bridle torn, a few streaks of blood on the feathers of its breast and on its talons, wild-eyed but still. The crowd has drawn back in a wide ring; two soldiers hold spears toward it from a distance. In the foreground on the left, kneeling beside the griffin's foreleg in full profile facing right, is the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat and steel plate: thick wavy warm-gold hair, sea-blue eyes, a grave face. Her left hand rests on the griffin's leg to steady it; her right hand is lifting, from where it was wound round one talon, a long strip of very old black cloth, a torn piece of a war banner, heavy and frayed, with a faded sun-disc emblem and no writing. She is staring at the cloth. High in the background, on the edge of a roof beside a bell tower, small against the sky, stands a young woman watching the street, facing us: dark gold hair in one long braid over her shoulder, plain dark travelling clothes, a long sword wrapped in cloth on her back; her weight is on her back foot, as if about to step away. Petals and bright dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：庆典上失控的狮鹫扑人，埃莉诺从它爪上取下一片古老的黑色军旗，塞西娅露了一面就退走。狮鹫身上写了一点血（卡里“落下了狮鹫的血”），人身上没有。地方参考用金鸢城王道中轴。

nodes.name: 门前一人
nodes.light: cold grey-gold spectral light from the army in the foreground, against the warm torchlight of the living street behind the gate, under a heavy dusk sky
nodes.camera: from among the front rank of the spectral army, low between their spears, looking at the lone woman in the gateway; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at an inner gate of a white and gold capital, the gate of a quarter of ordinary townspeople. From our side an army of the long dead is advancing on it: in the near foreground, close and out of focus, we see the backs of helmets of an ancient make, the shafts of spears and one tall black banner with a faded sun disc, all half transparent and edged with cold grey-gold light. Mist pours along the ground from the mouths of old tunnels behind us. In the middle of the gateway, alone and facing us, stands a young woman of twenty-one: dark gold hair in a single long braid over her right shoulder, a small old scar under her left eye, plain dark travelling clothes with a long coat. In her right hand she holds a long sword, still half wrapped in grey cloth, point down against the paving; her left arm is stretched straight out to her side across the gateway, palm open, barring the way. Her face is set and her eyes are wet; she looks straight at the dead soldiers. A flat bundle wrapped in the leather cover of an old book is tied at her belt. Behind her, through the arch, the street of the quarter runs away uphill: townspeople are fleeing with children and bundles, lamps are lit in windows, and across the street a line of living knights in blue surcoats is locking shields. Grey motes and torn shreds of mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：亡国军团冲出墓道扑向平民区，塞西娅站在城门前，在复国的口号和眼前的人之间选了一边。冠拿旧经书的封皮包着系在腰上。埃莉诺在后头的盾列里，不单画。

nodes.name: 塔顶
who: the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat
nodes.light: black-violet light pouring from a ring of great lamps round the tower top, with thin streams of pale spirit light rising into it, against the first grey of the hour before dawn
nodes.camera: from a roof below the tower, close behind the knight, looking steeply up at the tower top and the figure on it; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before dawn above a white and gold capital. A slender tower, the tallest in the city, rises through the picture and is cut off by its top edge; round its summit stands a ring of huge brass lamps with crystal lenses, built to shine like a sun, and every one of them now burns black-violet. From all over the city below, thin pale streams of light are being drawn up through the air and into that ring. On the summit platform inside the ring stands a giant figure of a young prince in ancient plate armour, four times the height of a man, facing us, a great sword held point-down before him in both hands: his right half is still made of soft golden light, his left half has gone dark as smoke, and a second, taller shadow in a long robe stands exactly behind him and is sinking into him. Behind his head hangs a perfect black disc with an even ring of pale fire all the way round it, a darkened sun worn like a crown; it is a full circle, and no part of it forms a crescent. In the near foreground on the left, on a rooftop, seen directly from behind, stands the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat and steel plate, her drawn sword held low in her right hand and her left hand raised to shield her eyes as she looks up. Beside her on the right, in full profile facing left toward the tower, stands a young woman of twenty-one in plain dark travelling clothes: dark gold hair in a single long braid, a long dark olive-brown coat over a pale shirt, a dull red cloth round her shoulders, dark trousers and tall brown boots, no robe and no finery. She is holding up in both hands a plain old crown of dull gold that gives off a steady warm light. Black sparks and pale wisps streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：死灵大公夺下太阳塔，把魔导灯阵改成召魂阵，王子的影子和更暗的东西叠在一起。日蚀画成一圈匀的白火围着黑的圆，写明不是月牙。塞西娅托着冠（页上没说她戴不戴，只画托着）。

nodes.name: 旧林
nodes.light: warm green-gold sunlight falling in long shafts through leaves from the upper left, with soft emerald shadow, and a small bright green glow over the spring
nodes.camera: low among ferns, close to the princess, looking past her up into the trunks of the old grove; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: inside a dream of a forest that died long ago: a grove of trees far older and taller than any that still stand, with silver bark and leaves of pale gold, rising like pillars out of sight; shafts of sun come down between them, deer and bright birds move in the distance, and everything is a little too perfect. At the edges of the picture the grove thins into white mist, as if it had been painted only as far as someone remembers it. In the middle lies a small clear spring among ferns, and above the water floats a seed the size of a fist, made of fresh green light, turning slowly. On the left, standing at the edge of the spring in full profile facing right, is the silver-haired elf princess: long straight silver-white hair, long pointed ears, pale green eyes, a ranger's long-sleeved travelling tunic and cloak in soft green and cream, a bow slung on her back. Her left hand rests flat against the silver bark of the nearest great tree; her right hand is half raised toward the floating seed and has stopped in the air. She is not looking at the seed but up into the leaves, and her face is open and unguarded, close to tears and smiling. On the moss at her feet lie last year's golden leaves, perfectly whole. Golden leaves and motes of green light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：春芽林里留着一片她记得、早已消失了的旧林地，走进去会亲眼看见那些树活着的样子。四季之种画成水上一颗绿光的种子。

nodes.name: 隔桥
who: the tall wood-elf ranger-general with dark green-blond hair
nodes.light: cold blue dusk under the canopy, with a dim sickly violet glow among the black vines on the right and warm small lamps of the court behind on the left
nodes.camera: a wide side view from below the bridge, looking up at the people facing each other across it; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in an elven court among the roots and boughs of a tree as large as a mountain. A long bridge made of one living root spans a gulf between two platforms. On the right half of the picture the far end of the bridge and the whole forest beyond it are filled with an army made of black vines: wolves, stags and tall man-shapes woven of dark briar, hundreds of them, silent, a dim violet light in their hollow chests. At their head, standing on the bridge in full profile facing left, is an old druid: a lean bearded man with long grey hair, a mantle sewn of dead brown leaves, bare feet, a plain wooden staff in his left hand. His right arm is held out toward the court, palm up, as one offers a gift; his face is gentle and utterly certain. On the left half of the picture, on the bridge and facing him in full profile facing right, stand two elves. In front is the silver-haired elf princess, long silver-white hair, a ranger's battle dress with long sleeves; her bow is in her left hand, lowered, with an arrow held along it unraised, and her right hand hangs at her side. She is listening to him, grieved and unyielding. One pace behind her stands the tall wood-elf ranger-general with dark green-blond hair, long pointed ears hung with small silver leaves, his own bow gripped in his left hand at his side and his right hand resting on the arrows at his hip. Behind them the lamps of the court glow among the boughs, and small figures of elves are closing doors. Dead leaves and violet motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：失去了森林的德鲁伊带着黑藤军团围住王庭，他真心相信这是在救它们。希露菲和埃兰迪尔守着月桥（不写月字）。两把弓都没拉开。

nodes.name: 噬根
nodes.light: a soft pale-green glow leaking from the bitten root in the middle, with a wide dim blue-green shimmer from a sea of spores below, against the black of a cavern
nodes.camera: from a narrow root bridge high in the cavern, close behind the small figure on it, looking across at the dragon; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a cavern under the roots of a tree as large as a mountain, so vast that its walls are lost in the dark. Roots as thick as towers come down through it like pillars and plunge into a sea of softly glowing blue-green spores far below; among them stand the broken arches and stairs of a city of ancient elves, overgrown. In the middle, wound round the greatest of the roots and cut off by the frame at both sides, lies an ancient dragon: a heavy Western wyrm with bat-like wings folded, pale grey-green scales grown over with moss and fungus, old beyond counting. Its jaws are closed on the root, and where its teeth have gone in, the wood is leaking a soft pale-green light like sap, which it is drinking. Its one visible eye is half shut and dreamy, like the eye of something falling asleep; it does not look fierce. In the foreground, on a narrow natural bridge of root, a small figure stands seen directly from behind: an elf woman with long straight silver-white hair and a ranger's cloak, a bow on her back. Her right hand is stretched out toward the dragon, open, not a weapon in it; her left hand holds the rope rail of the bridge. Three shapes of old guardians made of wood and stone lie fallen on a ledge below her. Glowing spores drift upward large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：根城里噬根古龙乌尔萨恩啃着树根，它是想钻进梦里躲开正在死去的现在。希露菲只画背影，不拿立绘当参考。

nodes.name: 岔路
nodes.light: flat cold grey-blue snow light under a low sky, with a hard white glare on the ice of the fort and one small warm torch among the group on the right
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the fork of the track, close to the warrior, looking past her at the ice fort on one side and the pass on the other; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a grey day in high snow country, at a place where a track divides. On the left the track runs on to an ice fort: a wall of blue-white ice as high as a cliff with the bones of some giant creature frozen inside it, towers of ice, and above its gate a war horn as long as a ship, cut off by the frame. Huge footprints and the drag-marks of a sledge lead to that gate. On the right the other track climbs toward a high pass between peaks, and there, small and waiting, stands a little escort: two fur-clad hunters with spears, one of them holding a torch, and between them a tall young dragonkin woman with rough white hair who faces us and hugs to her chest a large bundle wrapped in a coarse grey blanket. In the foreground, standing exactly at the fork, in full profile facing left toward the fort, is the tall silver-haired northern warrior: shaggy silver-white hair past her shoulders, pale icy blue eyes, a dark navy riveted leather coat with a fur collar and an iron pauldron. Her left hand holds up, at the height of her chest, a stiff frozen length of rope tied in an intricate sailor's knot that she has just pulled out of the snow; her right hand holds her great weapon by the haft with its head resting on the ground. She looks at the fort, her jaw tight, torn. Her own footprints behind her come from the direction of the escort. Fine snow and ice crystals drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：去圣泉的路上横着三座冰堡，巨人押走的长船猎手关在里头。追同族还是守住护送的队伍，希德在路上选一回。绳结是长船部族的。

nodes.name: 认出
nodes.light: cold blue-white storm light from the upper right, with a faint silver glow from the bundle in the young woman's arms and pale light inside the ice of the glacier
nodes.camera: low on the ice, a wide side view with the young woman on the left and the giant on the right, looking up so that he is cut off by the frame; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a storm over a glacier that is moving: the whole river of ice is sliding and cracking, and blocks of it rear up along its edges. On the far right, behind everything and cut off by the frame, stands a beast like a walking iceberg, a mountain of ice on four legs with horns of frozen spray, heavy chains hanging from its horns. In front of it, filling the right third of the picture and cut off at the top, stands the king of the frost giants in full profile facing left: six times the height of a person, grey-blue skin, a long white beard stiff with frost, a mantle of white furs, a crown of plain ice. His right hand holds the chain of the beast; his left hand is held out, low and open, toward the small figure before him, as one asks for something to be handed over. His face is hard, and under the hardness there is something that hesitates. On the left, standing on the ice in full profile facing right and looking up at him, is a tall young dragonkin woman of eighteen: rough white hair blown back, fine grey-blue scales at her temple and down her neck and on the backs of her hands, a heavy fur coat. Both her arms hold tight against her chest a large egg wrapped in a coarse grey blanket of giant weaving, from which a faint silver light shows. Her mouth is open, speaking to him; her eyes are full, and she does not step back. Far behind her, small on the ice, a silver-haired warrior in a navy coat is running toward them. Driven snow and chips of ice streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：霜巨人王赫洛姆赶着冰山巨兽追上移动的冰川，莱茵娜望着那个高大的身影，说出了一直没说的话（他是教她辨风的人）。她说了什么不画。希德在远处，不拿立绘。

nodes.name: 圣泉
nodes.light: silver-white light breaking from the cracks of the egg in the middle, with flashes of red fire, blue frost and white lightning from the dragons in the cloud above, against a black storm sky
nodes.camera: low beside the steaming spring, looking up past the egg and the two women into the storm full of dragons; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the summit of a mountain range in a thunderstorm at night. In a hollow of black rock lies a small round spring whose water steams in the snow. In the spring, half under the water, rests an egg the size of a barrel with a shell like tarnished silver; cracks have opened across it, and silver-white light is breaking out of them in beams. Above the summit, filling the whole sky and cut off by the frame, three flights of dragons are fighting in the thundercloud: red ones breathing fire, pale blue ones breathing frost, grey ones wrapped in lightning, dozens of heavy Western wyrms with bat-like wings, wheeling and clashing over who shall have what is in that egg. Beside the spring on the right, kneeling in the snow in full profile facing left toward the egg, is a tall young dragonkin woman: rough white hair, grey-blue scales at her temple and neck, a heavy fur coat. Both her hands are laid flat on the shell, and her lips are parted, speaking or singing low to it. In the foreground on the left, seen directly from behind, stands the tall silver-haired northern warrior in a dark navy riveted leather coat with a fur collar: her feet are planted wide, and she holds her great weapon raised across her body in both hands, facing the sky, guarding the two behind her. Her hair and coat stream to the right in the wind. A fallen dragon lies smoking on a far ridge. Snow, sparks and silver motes streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：北境的古龙和飞龙巢群为首领的血脉在雷云里混战，山顶圣泉边守住孵化的仪式。壳只裂了缝，出没出壳不画。

nodes.name: 摘印
nodes.light: warm orange forge light from a great hearth on the right, against the black stone of the hall, with a first faint blue-white glow waking in the key on its stand
nodes.camera: at table height, from the end of the long table, looking along it at the princess on one side and the elders on the other; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening in the council hall of a fortress city of smiths, built of black basalt: a long stone table, iron lamps, and at the end of the hall a great forge hearth burning orange. Along the far side of the table sit seven elders of the city, horned demon-kin men and women with soot-dark hands and heavy leather aprons over good clothes, some with small flames burning at the tips of their horns; they sit with folded arms and wary, unimpressed faces. At the head of the table on a low iron stand rests a large old city key, dull and dead, except that a first thin thread of blue-white light has begun to glow along its teeth. On the near side of the table, standing in full profile facing right toward the elders, is the wine-red-haired demon princess: long wine-red hair, two small curved black horns half hidden in it, large ruby eyes, a dark high-collared court dress with long sleeves. She has taken off her signet of rank, a heavy gold ring on a chain, and it lies on the table in front of her, pushed away from her toward them. Her right hand is laid flat on a long unrolled contract, a sheet covered with ruled lines and wax seals but no readable writing; her left hand holds a pen. She is leaning forward a little and speaking, earnest, without her practised smile. Behind the elders, through a tall window, the dark shape of a mountain shows, and above its shoulder hangs a black sphere ringed with a thin even circle of red fire, a black sun, a full circle with no crescent to it. Sparks from the hearth drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：一座一座城去唤醒钥匙，卡麦莉加得亲自跟每座城的契约民谈，皇女的身份开不了门。挑了苍焰角城那一座。皇女的印是我补的摆法。黑日画成红火匀着围一圈的黑球。

nodes.name: 钥匙塔
who: the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat
nodes.light: a clear blue-white glow from the key at the top of the tower in the middle, against a red-black sky, with cold lamps along the street and no light at all on the advancing soldiers
nodes.camera: low on the street at the foot of the tower steps, close to the princess, looking up the street at the oncoming army and up at the tower; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a street of a capital built of black obsidian, lit by rows of cold lamps. In the middle of a small square stands a slender tower of black glass, cut off by the top of the frame, and at its top a great city key hangs in the air and shines blue-white; a dome of the same faint light falls from it over the square. In the sky behind, above a railway viaduct, hangs a huge black sphere ringed with a thin even circle of red fire, a black sun, a full circle with no crescent to it. Down the street from the viaduct comes an army: rank upon rank of soldiers in the tattered armour of old wars, and every one of them is without a face, the front of each helmet and each hood only a smooth dark blank; they carry no banners. Where they pass, the name-plates on the doors go blank. On the steps of the tower, in the foreground on the right, in full profile facing left toward the army, stands the wine-red-haired demon princess in the black field coat: long wine-red hair, two small curved black horns, ruby eyes hard. Her right arm is thrust straight out toward the army with the hand open, and in front of it turns a wide ring of red contract light without readable letters, from which a wall of thin red lines spreads across the street; her left hand grips a thick ledger against her side. Behind her on the steps, inside the dome of light, a crowd of townspeople crouch together, horned and unhorned, holding children, unhurt. Red sparks and flakes of ash streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：噬名的残念借列车开进烬灭之都，放出亡魂和无名者凑成的军团，钥匙塔立在街巷之间。没有名字画成没有脸、门牌变空白。账册是找回来的姓名记录。

nodes.name: 终点
nodes.light: seven thin coloured lights along the rail under the train, against a vast black sphere ahead ringed with red fire, in a sky with no stars
nodes.camera: from above and behind the locomotive, close over the shoulder of the small figure on its roof, looking forward along the rail into the black sphere; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an armoured steam train is running through empty air on a railway that is made only of light: two rails woven of seven thin coloured lights, blue-white, red, bone-white, violet, storm-grey, yellow and sea-green, laid out ahead of the engine across a void. Straight ahead, filling the upper half of the picture and cut off by the frame, is a colossal black sphere ringed with a thin even circle of red fire, a black sun, a full circle with no crescent to it; the rail of light runs up into it. Inside the black of the sphere, faint and enormous, something is taking shape: the back and the arms of a throne, half built, with no one on it. Behind the engine the carriages are coming apart one by one: the last has already broken loose and is falling away into the void in pieces, the next is splitting along its rivets, plates and wheels trailing behind. In the foreground, on the roof of the locomotive, a small figure stands seen directly from behind: a young demon-kin woman with long wine-red hair streaming back and two small curved black horns, in a fitted black coat with a wine-red lining that whips behind her. Her right hand grips an iron handrail on the roof; her left hand holds up, at arm's length in front of her toward the sphere, a ring on which seven keys hang and burn, each in one of the seven colours. Smoke from the funnel streams back past her. Sparks and shards of iron streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：七把钥匙合在一处铺出通往黑日内部的轨道，装甲列车一节一节崩坏，车头前方是一座正在成形的王座。卡麦莉加只画背影，不拿立绘。

nodes.name: 空船
nodes.light: one small warm oil lamp hanging in the cabin doorway on the right, against grey fog and pale daylight, with the white of the sails above
nodes.camera: low on the empty deck, close to the kneeling warrior, looking along the deck toward the bow and up at the sails; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a foggy morning in a harbour. A white-sailed ship has come in against the quay with no one aboard: her sails are full and tight although there is no wind, her wheel turns a little by itself, and her deck is clean and empty. Through the open door of the deckhouse on the right we see a table laid for a meal, bowls still set out, a bench pushed back, and a small oil lamp burning on its hook. On the quay beyond the rail, in the fog, lies the huge pale shell of a crab as big as a cart, fallen and still, and dock workers stand round it at a distance. In the foreground, kneeling on the deck beside the foot of the mast in full profile facing right, is the tall silver-haired northern warrior: shaggy silver-white hair past her shoulders, pale icy blue eyes, a dark navy riveted leather coat with a fur collar and an iron pauldron. In both hands she holds up the frayed end of a rope that is made fast to the mast; in the rope, just above the break, is tied an intricate sailor's knot, and she is looking at that knot with her lips pressed together, recognising it. Her great weapon lies on the deck beside her knee. On the rail behind her sits a single large sea-conch that no one has put there, its mouth toward her. Wisps of fog and specks of spray drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：空无一人的白帆船靠了岸，潮骨巨蟹打倒了，希德在残绳上认出失踪同族的结，诺雅的声音封在一只海螺里。海螺搁在栏上是我补的摆法。

nodes.name: 鲸骨泊地
nodes.light: a single warm ship's lantern beside the warrior, against a deep blue night full of stars, with pale starlight on enormous white bones
nodes.camera: low on the foredeck of a small ship, close to the seated warrior, looking up through the ribs that arch over the cove; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a still night in a sheltered cove of a small island. The skeleton of a whale as large as a hill lies half in the water, and its white ribs arch high over the cove from one side to the other like the vault of a cathedral, cut off by the top of the frame; stars show between them. Under the ribs a small ship lies at anchor on black water, her sails furled. On her foredeck, sitting on a coil of rope with her back against the rail, in full profile facing right, is the tall silver-haired northern warrior, off watch and without her armour: shaggy silver-white hair loose over her shoulders, pale icy blue eyes, a plain thick long-sleeved wool tunic and trousers, a blanket over her knees. A lantern stands on the deck at her side. In her left hand she holds, tilted to the lantern, a torn piece of an old sea chart, a scrap of stained vellum with coastlines and small drawn reefs but no writing; her right hand rests on her knee, loosely holding a frayed rope's end tied in an intricate knot. She is not looking at the chart. Her head is tipped back a little and she looks up at the ribs, her face unguarded and troubled. Across the deck, small in the background, a young woman with long blue-black hair sits by the mast with her back to us, writing on a small wax tablet. Fireflies of lantern light and specks of sea mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：古航图散在雾礁、鲸骨岛、海盗墓湾。泊地的夜里希德头一回怀疑死在海上是不是真的光荣。画的是静的一幅。她穿私服。

nodes.name: 终曲
nodes.light: rings of warm golden light spreading from the singer in the middle through deep blue water, with a cold white glow from the opening doors
nodes.camera: low on the seabed stair, a little behind and to the side of the singer, looking up at the doors that tower over her; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the bottom of the sea, deep blue and still. A broad stair of white stone grown with coral climbs to a pair of doors as tall as a cliff, built of coral, pearl and green bronze, cut off by the top of the frame; the ruins of a drowned city, towers and arches, stand dim in the water on either side. The doors are opening: a line of cold white light has split them from top to bottom and is widening, and through the gap show the pillars of a palace of coral, a garden where the water flows upward, and far within and below, very small, an empty throne above a great darkness. In the middle, on the stair before the doors, a young woman of twenty stands in full profile facing right toward them, singing: long blue-black hair floating out behind her in the water, wind-reddened cheeks, a plain dock worker's coat and trousers. A thin skin of air clings round her whole body like a bubble. Her head is lifted and her mouth is open in song; her right hand is laid on her chest over a small sea-conch on a cord, which glows, and her left arm is held out a little from her side, palm open. From her, ring after ring of warm golden light is spreading outward through the water, and where the rings touch the doors the coral lights up. Behind her on the lower steps, seen directly from behind and small, stands a tall warrior with silver-white hair and a navy coat inside her own bubble of air, a great weapon in her hands, watching the dark on either side. Bubbles and golden motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 四幕阶段④：诺雅找回歌声，海底的大门为她打开，珊瑚宫殿、倒流花园、深渊王座。王座底下按着什么不画，只画一片暗。希德在后头，不拿立绘。
